item.title: [github_trending] tt-a1i/archify
item.description: Archify is a Node.js rendering and validation system for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex CLI, and OpenCode. It turns a codebase or system description into an interactive system map directly in chat, compiling typed JSON IR into self-contained HTML/SVG. It ships with five diagram types, four presets, light/dark themes, and Before/Delta/After snapshots for reviewing architecture changes before merge.

item.description: A practical guide to configuring Claude Code, sharing 32 tested Skills and 8 MCP servers with copy-paste npx install commands. The author clarifies the difference between Skills (prompt/workflow packs) and MCP (local tools/API services), and includes a fix for the npm install prefix. Useful for developers who want Claude Code to handle docs, code review, and more automatically.

It's a reworked spin-off of UAV Downloader. Good for developers who want a scriptable download tool with a lighter dependency stack.

item.title: [infoq] 腾讯混元 Hy4 preview 开源，参与“训练自己”！WorkBuddy实测：有了小型团队交付实力，但还得有人盯
item.description: Tencent has open-sourced Hunyuan Hy4 preview with 770B total parameters, 49B active, and 1M+ context, tuned for agent, coding, and productivity tasks. It was involved in optimizing its own training and operators, forming a recursive self-improvement loop, and improving end-to-end throughput by 31.8%. API pricing is 6 CNY input and 18 CNY output per million tokens; WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy are free for two weeks.

item.title: [infoq] 你的 Agent 已经上线生产环境，下一步怎么办？ | 技术实践
item.description: Snowflake is expanding Cortex Agents with new capabilities for enterprises running agents in production, targeting operational pain points in orchestration, execution, and governance. Highlights include the Async Agent API, interrupt/resume, partial access controls, and a versioning UI, along with previews like Build Coding Agent and Tool Search — aimed at moving agents from "buildable" to "operable at scale."

item.title: [v2ex] [分享创造] 做一个 iOS 27 风格的 V2EX 客户端 - 关于这个应用的上架说明以及三轮审核情况
item.description: An iOS 27-style V2EX client built with SwiftUI and Liquid Glass was rejected three times in App Store review, ultimately for 4.3(a) Spam over similarity to existing clients. The developer says the code is original and open source, free, with 78 TestFlight testers; an appeal has been filed.

item.title: [infoq] 1周半写64个PR、完成30%项目重构：一家成熟SaaS公司把Agent塞进研发全流程后
item.description: Calendly, a scheduling SaaS company, detailed how it embeds AI agents across Jira, GitHub, CI and production workflows: agents review requirements, split tasks, write code in parallel, run tests and QA, with humans doing final review and merge. In its IAM team, agents generated 64 PRs in one and a half weeks and completed about 30% of a large decoupling project. The takeaway: the bottleneck is shifting from writing code to requirement alignment and judgment.

item.title: [infoq] 智谱认领“牛来”模型，实测：“牛马”友好
item.description: Zhipu confirmed that Ox Alpha, the anonymous model that climbed OpenRouter's trending list, is GLM-5.3-Flash. It is a mixture-of-experts model with 320B total parameters but only about 18B active per token; the anonymous test version offered 1.04M-token context and accepted text, image, and video input. Stripe CEO Patrick Collison said it was 'very impressive,' and Zhipu said all test traffic ran on clusters built with domestic AI chips.

item.title: [infoq] 谷歌落后一个时代？CEO 亲自官宣“语音转文字”模型，网友：你们看不清形势啊
item.description: Google unveiled Gemini 3.5 Transcribe, which CEO Pichai announced on X as its most accurate speech-to-text model. It cleans up fillers, mistakes, and repetitions, understands self-corrections like 'no, make it Wednesday,' supports 85+ languages with live switching, and can identify up to eight speakers. According to Artificial Analysis, word error rate is 4.0% for streaming and 2.6% for non-streaming transcription.

item.description: Cloudflare detailed how it turned internal engineering standards from passive docs into AI-enforced controls: its AI code review tool has flagged nearly 230,000 violations since early 2026, with almost 16,000 causing approvals to be rejected. Standards are defined in RFCs with SHOULD/MUST levels and roll out through an advisory, observe, then enforce process, also applied to technical designs and incident reports. This model suits organizations that need to review massive numbers of changes from

It runs browser components in isolated WebAssembly/Rust environments on Cloudflare Workers, supports the Chrome DevTools Protocol, so Playwright and Puppeteer can drive it with lower overhead than full Chromium. item.description: The World AI Open Source Competition (GOAI) has entered its rematch round: tracks 1–3 must submit by Sept 3 18:00, while track 4 debugging runs into mid-September. The Agent Infra track now demands an AgentTeams-based design with at least three distinct agents, along with validation, code, and a demo video. Online defenses are Sept 4–6.

item.title: [infoq] 规模化 AI 代码审查：LinkedIn 的多智能体方案
item.description: LinkedIn built a multi-agent AI code review platform instead of bolting a generic tool onto GitHub. It combines independent reviewers using different models and reasoning methods, applies organization- and repo-specific rules, and filters noise. In an evaluation of 5,230 sampled comments across 1,727 PRs, 63.9% of suggestions were adopted; logic-error and concurrency fixes were accepted 80% and 100% of the time respectively.

item.title: [github_trending] bilawalsidhu/gods-eye-view
item.description: God's Eye View is an open-source browser app that turns public satellite and sensor data into a live, photorealistic 3D globe — showing aircraft, ships, satellites, earthquakes, traffic, and public cameras in real time. It comes from the viral God's Eye View YouTube series (5M+ views) and offers hands-free voice control via a realtime AI agent; modeled views are clearly labeled when no live feed exists. Great for developers into open-source geospatial visualization and real-time data mashups.

item.title: [juejin] Codex 穷鬼大救星
item.description: A new open-source workflow, codex_with_cc, turns Codex into a planning/QA lead while subagents do the heavy lifting: Claude Code runs on a DeepSeek backend via CC Switch, dramatically cutting token costs. The author reports 60 million tokens with a 98.5% cache hit rate cost about ¥2, thanks to DeepSeek's ¥0.02 per 1M cached tokens. It targets developers watching Codex burn through their quota.

item.title: [hackernews] Saving 100 terabytes of memory by optimizing 1.1.1.1's DNS cache
item.description: Cloudflare describes five Rust-level memory optimizations applied to the DNS cache layout behind 1.1.1.1 (internally codenamed Big Pineapple). Per-entry memory dropped by 56%, freeing roughly 100 TB of memory across the company's fleet. Worth reading if you work on DNS infrastructure or large-scale Rust performance tuning.

item.title: [hackernews] Small Models Have Arrived
item.description: In this post, Calvin French-Owen argues that small AI models have arrived, citing his hands-on experience with gpt-5.6-luna — it's fast (~100 tps), capable, and costs only tens of cents even when searching across thousands of emails. He connects this to why consumer AI companies are scarce: token costs used to be the bottleneck. GLM 5.3 is also mentioned as a new Pareto-frontier option.

item.title: [hackernews] Microduck
item.description: Microduck is a 25 cm biped robot with 15 motors, a camera, LiDAR, and a grasping beak. It is playable out of the box, and its open-source stack lets you train new behaviors in simulation before deploying them to the real robot. At a $399 pre-order price, it appeals to hobbyists and researchers exploring robot learning on a budget.

item.title: [juejin] 面试官问你：“AI 能写 80% 的代码了，公司为什么还需要你？”
item.description: This post offers a framework for a common 2026 interview question: 'If AI can write 80% of the code, why do companies still need you?' It argues that answers like 'AI code is low quality' or 'AI doesn't understand business' no longer land, and suggests framing humans as decision-makers and system architects. The author illustrates with an e-commerce countdown timer example. Relevant for developers preparing for AI-era interviews.

item.description: JetBrains released go-modern-guidelines, an official project that teaches AI coding agents to write modern Go.
